title: Glue a submodule with the ambient module across two opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W,V$ opens, and $H$ a quasi-coherent module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] of finite type on $W$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Let $Q$ be a quasi-coherent finite-type module on $V$ with a monomorphism $\iota:Q\to H|_V$ whose restriction to $W\cap V$ is an isomorphism. There exists a quasi-coherent finite-type module $G$ on $W\cup V$ and a monomorphism $\varphi:G\to H|_{W\cup V}$ whose restriction to $W$ is an isomorphism. Neither compactness nor affineness is assumed; the compatible submodule on $V$ is given, not constructed.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (label lemma-extend), proof: gluing on two opens with their common overlap value; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: Identify the monomorphism Q -> H restricted to V with its image subsheaf. For every open T contained in W union V, take the submodule of H(T) of sections whose restriction to T intersect V lies in that image. Restriction preserves the condition. Compatible sections glue in H and their restrictions glue in the image subsheaf, so this defines a module sheaf G and an inclusion G -> H on the union.

On V this is the image subsheaf, hence is isomorphic to Q. On W every restriction condition is vacuous because the intersection lies in W intersect V, where the given inclusion is an isomorphism. Thus the inclusion of G is an isomorphism on W and a monomorphism on the union.

Local presentations on W for H and on V for Q cover the union and are presentations of G there, proving quasi-coherence. The finite generating families on these two opens similarly give finite type. Empty and disjoint opens obey the same sectionwise construction.

theorem exists_submodule_binary_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent]
    [(H.over W).IsFiniteType]
    (Q : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
    [Q.IsQuasicoherent] [Q.IsFiniteType] (ι : Q ⟶ H.over V) [Mono ι]
    [IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (show W ⊓ V ≤ V from inf_le_right))).map ι)] :
    ∃ G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (W ⊔ V)),
      G.IsQuasicoherent ∧ G.IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (φ : G ⟶ H.over (W ⊔ V)),
        Mono φ ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_left))).map φ)
